props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name — what the globe is showing.

props.name: size
props.description: Pixel size of the square canvas.

props.name: dots
props.description: Dots on the sphere. Higher looks denser, not larger.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Axial tilt in degrees, so it does not read as a flat ring of dots.

props.name: dotColor
props.description: Any CSS colour for the land dots.

props.name: markerColor
props.description: Any CSS colour for the marked points.
